title: Return Methods Offered and Method Fee Settings by Return Type
content:
Returns & Exchanges offers three ways to send a return back to Marlowe & Finch: a mail label, a carrier drop-off QR code and a scheduled pickup. The return type decides which of them are offered and whether a return method fee is withheld.

| Return type | Mail label | Carrier drop-off QR code | Scheduled pickup | Return method fee withheld | Method fee can be waived by a Marlowe Rewards free return label tier or an Unlimited plan covering return labels |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Return | Offered | Offered | Offered | Yes | Yes |
| Store Credit Return | Offered | Offered | Offered | No | Yes |
| Size Exchange | Offered | Offered | Offered | No | Yes |
| Instant Exchange | Offered | Offered | Offered | No | Yes |
| Gift Return | Offered | Offered | Offered | No | No |
| Quality Issue Return | Offered | Offered | Not offered | No | No |

## Points read from the table

- The Quality Issue Return is the only type without a scheduled pickup; its parcel travels by mail label or carrier drop-off QR code.
- The Standard Return is the only type on which a return method fee is withheld.
- The waivable setting records whether the type allows a waiver of the method fee at all; it is on for the Standard Return, Store Credit Return, Size Exchange and Instant Exchange, and off for the Gift Return and the Quality Issue Return.

Example (hypothetical): a customer opening a Quality Issue Return who asks for a scheduled pickup is offered a mail label or a carrier drop-off QR code instead, because the scheduled pickup is not offered for that type.
